name: Sonoma County Fish and Wildlife Commission grants

funder.name: Sonoma County Fish and Wildlife Commission

summary: County grants from a fish and wildlife fund for projects that improve fish or wildlife habitat, teach conservation science, or protect and propagate fish and wildlife in Sonoma County, California.
reporting: A final project report is due within 60 days after the project ends; progress reports may be required, and the Commission may inspect the project on site.

eligibility.rule: Project activities fit one of the listed purposes, such as habitat improvement or conservation education

documents: Two letters of recommendation supporting the project
Three bids for supplies or equipment, if purchased, rented or leased
W-9 form from the current fiscal year

geography.quote: California Fish and Wildlife Code Section 13100 requires that funds deposited into the Sonoma County Fish and Wildlife Special Revenue Fund be distributed to deserving projects that benefit fish and wildlife.

access.quote: Complete applications may be submitted to:

reporting.quote: Grant recipients are required to submit a Final Project Report within 60 days after completion of the project.

effort.quote: All grant requests must be submitted to the Sonoma County Agricultural Commissioner's Office no less than two weeks prior to the Commission's regular meeting.
Members of the Fish and Wildlife Commission will receive a copy of each submitted application for pre-review.
At a regular meeting, the Fish and Wildlife Commission will formally accept submitted application and discuss it.

eligibility.quote: In order to be considered, project activities must be limited to one of the following: Improvement of fish or wildlife habitat. Public education relating to the scientific principles of fish and wildlife conservation or operation of nature study facilities.

after_award.quote: Grant recipients are required to submit a Final Project Report within 60 days after completion of the project.
The Sonoma County Fish and Wildlife Commission reserves the right to schedule an on-site inspection of the project during the course of the project term.

documents.quote: Two letters of recommendation in support of the project must accompany the application.
Three bids must accompany the application for purchase/rental/leasing of supplies and equipment.
All grant requests must include a W9 from the current Fiscal Year at the time of submission.
